claims.statement: FMC rules specify eligible billed parties, invoice timing, required information, and minimum dispute windows, with most provisions still in effect in 2026.
Demand hypothesis: standardized DCSA events make automated charge reconstruction feasible enough for TMS-embedded recovery economics.

contrary_evidence: FMC data show billed and collected charges fell from peak levels.
Forwarders and audit firms already dispute these invoices manually.

economics.acquisition_route: One TMS or forwarder integration supplies recurring importer volume.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 4000 monthly audits plus recovery fees can exceed 5 million PLN annual revenue and support founder wealth above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Four hours daily until exception review can be delegated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 70-85% margin after analyst review of high-value disputes.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 250 audits monthly at 150 PLN average repay the build within eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 80-250 PLN per audited invoice plus 8-15% of waived charges.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every delayed container can create a new charge and dispute deadline.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Carrier, port, and lane-specific event and dispute outcomes become proprietary benchmarks.
fingerprint.customer: EU importers, freight forwarders, and NVOCCs exposed to US container charges.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: TMS vendors and freight forwarders embed it into invoice-audit workflows.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Software reconciles carrier events, contracts, and invoice fields into a dispute-ready evidence pack.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The importer or forwarder pays per container audit and a share of waived charges.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A carrier or terminal invoice arrives with disputed dates, party, free time, or causation.

founder_fit: The rules and event matching fit analytical automation.
Embedded TMS distribution avoids constant relationship selling.
risks: The product must avoid unauthorized legal representation.
Incomplete terminal events could produce false positives.

structure.control_point: The container timeline linked to each charge and resolution.
structure.critical_dependency: Timely carrier, terminal, and DCSA event data.

thesis: An event-to-invoice auditor can identify noncompliant detention and demurrage charges and assemble a timely waiver or refund request.
title: Demurrage Invoice Dispute Auditor
uncertainties: EU importer exposure to recoverable US-lane charges is unknown.
TMS access and revenue share are unverified.
